Name: Baarbara Estate - Honey Sundried Processed
Tasting_Notes: Expect a bright, fruity aroma with notes of berries , a rounded body , and a lingering sweetness
Desc:
Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed Arabica   Single Origin | Medium Roast | Limited Estate Release  
 Nestled in the misty heights of the Western Ghats,  Baarbara Estate  is a third-generation coffee plantation run by the  Indavara family , proud cultivators of coffee since  1896  under  MG Plantations . With over 120 years of heritage and a deep-rooted commitment to sustainability, the estate is certified by both  UTZ  and the  Rainforest Alliance . 
 At elevations ranging from  3,850 to 5,350 feet , this estate produces exceptional  Selection 795 Arabica , shade-grown in rich biodiversity. The result is a coffee that truly reflects the unique terroir of  Chikmagalur , near the sacred foothills of  Bababudan Giri  India’s coffee cradle. 
 At Korebi Coffee, we collaborate closely with estates like Baarbara to  develop a roast that captures the estate’s unique character and natural expression . This year’s release is a  Honey Processed  lot, using a time-intensive and flavor-rich technique. 
 ☀️ About the Honey Sun-Dried Process: 
 In the  honey process , freshly pulped beans are  left with some of their sticky mucilage intact  and then  sun-dried on raised beds . This method named for the golden, honey-like texture of the drying beans enhances the coffee’s  natural sweetness and fruity depth , while preserving the  clarity and balance  of a washed coffee. It’s a labor of love that results in a cup with exceptional character. 
 ☕ Tasting Notes: 
 Expect a  bright, fruity aroma  with notes of  berries , a  rounded body , and a  lingering sweetness . The  medium roast  preserves the vibrant complexity of the honey process while delivering a smooth, balanced finish. 
  Key Features:  
 
 
  100% Arabica | Single Origin | Shade Grown  
 
 
  Honey Sun-Dried for Sweet, Fruit-Forward Notes  
 
 
  Ethically Sourced | UTZ & Rainforest Alliance Certified  
 
 
  Handpicked at High Elevation (3850–5350 ft)  
 
 
  Available as Whole Bean or Freshly Ground  
 
 
 Perfect for those who seek  sweet, nuanced, and expertly processed coffee ,  Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed  is a standout in our estate collection and a true expression of Indian specialty coffee done right.

Name: Bubble Bliss - Anaerobic Fermented
Tasting_Notes: Bubble Bliss has a very sweet aroma and tastes almost like chocolate with a hint of raisins
Process: called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this
Desc:
Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a process called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this. This blend is made in micro batches and each batch is processed in a fully sealed vacuum chamber without the presence of any oxygen. It took us months of tweaking to perfect our process and we call the product Bubble Bliss. The name is a riff on the process, as it was processed in a bubble, as some would say! 
 Bubble Bliss has a very sweet aroma and tastes almost like chocolate with a hint of raisins. It brews a flavour balanced cup every time, this is for those who love consistency. 
 Bubble Bliss is made with 100% shade-grown, single origin, AAA Grade Arabica. Available as whole  beans or ground  for your choice of equipment. 
  Perfect for those who appreciate complex and balanced flavors, this blend is available in various grind options to suit your brewing method.

Name: Pineapple Express
Tasting_Notes: pineapple, it carries the spirit of tropical innovation in every sip
Desc:
Pineapple Express - 2025 Harvest  
  Pineapple Fermentation | Microlot Series  
 Welcome to the cutting edge of Indian specialty coffee.  Pineapple Express  is a bold and vibrant microlot crafted at  Barbara Estate , nestled in the highlands of  Baba Budangiri, Chikmagalur . Grown at an elevation of  1550m  and fermented using ripe pineapple, this coffee is the result of pioneering post-harvest innovation - an experiment in flavor that delivers a one-of-a-kind sensory experience. 
 This  medium roast  100% Arabica coffee opens with a  winey acidity  and  sweet dried fruit aroma , evolving into notes of  apple, dried mango, vanilla, and caramel , with a whisper of spice and a refined, spirit-like finish. It's the perfect harmony of brightness and sweetness - delightfully unexpected, yet beautifully balanced. 
 Whether you brew it as espresso, French press, moka pot, or cold brew,  Pineapple Express  is a journey worth taking.   Why Pineapple Fermentation?  The pineapple not only contributes natural sugars and microbial diversity to enhance fermentation, but it also accelerates mucilage breakdown, ensuring a cleaner drying process and a mold-free bean. The result is a coffee bursting with flavor, though it doesn’t taste like pineapple, it carries the  spirit of tropical innovation  in every sip.

Name: The Bourbon - Limited Edition
Tasting_Notes: Tennessee Whiskey resulting in an exciting and unique drinking experience
Desc:
The beans are hand rolled daily to ensure all the coffee comes into contact with the oak barrel over the course of several weeks. It is the perfect complement to some sweet dessert. We hail from a dry state, so no alcohol! 
 The green beans have absorbed beautiful bourbon aromas and flavors of Tennessee Whiskey resulting in an exciting and unique drinking experience. These beans are alcohol free, as any alcohol residue from the aging process is evaporated off during roasting. All the whiskey you can taste is flavor only. This is a small batch, limited edition project, sold in limited quantities. 
 By using single origin 100% arabica beans we have created a really well balanced smooth coffee, true but delicate flavors of bourbon run through this drink leaving a sweet dark chocolate liqueur coffee. You can taste the barrels in the aroma, with a rush of blackcurrant and forest fruits. The taste is funky, sweet, rich & smooth. We suggest an Iced Pour Over or a  Cold Brew  for peak taste experience. 
  Perfect for a special dessert coffee experience, this limited edition blend offers a rich and unique flavor profile.
